name: cost-visibility
description: Live cost, context, and plan-quota meters above the Claude Code prompt (Nerd Font required for icons). Type /spend for the detail pane. Optional cost guards via /spend caps on.

costGuards.title: Cost guards
costGuards.description: When on, block /code-review max|xhigh|ultra|braba, background agents, and multi-angle review fan-out. Off by default (HUD only). Toggle with /spend caps on|off or /config.
